title: Stasis Spellforge
description: A surreal scene inside a derelict room with a crumbling ceiling and light beams piercing through. Three masked heads in white, red, and purple emerge from sand in the foreground, while a large ornate painting in the center depicts a green moon, a staircase with a red figure, and exploding pink floral bursts that spill into the room.
prompt: Surreal scene inside a decaying abandoned room with cracked walls covered in black spiral graffiti and the words STASIS SPELLFORGE. Beams of light break through a destroyed ceiling. In the foreground, three human heads emerge from sand wearing theatrical masks: one white, one red, one purple, each decorated with black spirals. A large ornate picture frame leans against the wall containing a fantastical painting of a green moon, a staircase leading into the sky, and a red figure reaching upward, with pink flower-like explosions bursting out from the painting into the real room.
